caption: The drawing displays a sleeveless, high-collared vest with a brown base color, adorned with symmetrical, intricate floral and geometric embroidery in green, pink, white, and blue hues across the front. The pattern features vertical alignment along the center and horizontal bands at lower and hem areas. The garment has a narrow stand-up collar and armholes outlined with a contrasting lighter color. To the upper right of the detailed vest is a simplified line sketch of the same item, showing the outline and shape from the back with minimal detail. The objects are set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Sleeveless Jacket
